spec.title: AI-Native Lean card G — Named checked examples

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Use a named theorem in checked source when an example needs a G1 witness.

p.APPLICABILITY: A guide example is being used as evidence that a property holds.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Example module, explicit theorem subject, real checker and artifact identity.

p.SCOPE: The targeted checker checks registered named examples. Automatic extraction/checking of documentation fences is WISH; prose examples are explanatory until checked as source.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: An anonymous example is useful Lean code, but cannot substitute for a selected named carrier theorem.

p.RISKS: A copied snippet can drift from its checked source; retire or update it when theorem/source identity changes. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.

band-three.title: Band 3 — Operation
band-three.fence: trigger: WHEN A guide example is being used as evidence that a property holds. mode: gate routine: 1. Locate the actual example source. 2. Give the property a named theorem. 3. Bind its exact subject. 4. Run the pinned checker. 5. Keep explanatory prose distinct from the resulting witness. checker: lean-ai-native --path . check --carrier lean-proof.toml --subject <fully-qualified-subject> raid_role: layer=proof; order=after:independent-contract; batch=theorem budget: active_rules=1; first_signal=one targeted operation within its configured bound
